description: This file defines a utility class 'Pools' for managing object pools, including synchronized and non-synchronized implementations, used for object reuse in Android development.

classes.name: Pools
classes.description: Helper class providing object pool implementations for reuse.

classes.name: Pools.Pool
classes.description: Interface for managing a pool of objects.

classes.name: Pools.SimplePool
classes.description: A non-synchronized implementation of an object pool.

classes.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool
classes.description: A thread-safe implementation of an object pool extending SimplePool.

methods.name: Pools.Pool.acquire
methods.description: Returns an instance from the pool if available.

methods.name: Pools.Pool.release
methods.description: Releases an instance back into the pool.

methods.name: Pools.SimplePool.<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pool with a maximum size.

methods.name: Pools.SimplePool.acquire
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the pool if available.

methods.name: Pools.SimplePool.release
methods.description: Adds an object back into the pool.

methods.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool.<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing the synchronized pool with a maximum size.

methods.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool.acquire
methods.description: Thread-safely retrieves an object from the pool.

methods.name: Pools.SynchronizedPool.release
methods.description: Thread-safely releases an object into the pool.
